product_offering.core_offering: Resend provides a developer-first email API platform for sending transactional and marketing emails at scale. The offering includes a REST API with SDKs across 9 languages, SMTP relay support, multi-region sending infrastructure, managed dedicated IPs, webhooks, and the open-source React Email component library for building email templates. The platform is complemented by Audiences (contact management), Broadcasts (no-code marketing campaigns), Automations (workflow sequences), and Inbound Emails for two-way email handling.
product_offering.differentiator: React Email integration (open source component library for beautiful emails), multi-region sending for reduced latency, managed dedicated IPs with automatic warm-up, superior developer experience vs legacy providers (SendGrid, Mailgun, Postmark), generous free tier, SOC 2 and GDPR compliance, 9 official SDKs across major languages
product_offering.functional_benefit: Simple API integration (go from hello world to production in minutes), reliable email deliverability with inbox placement focus, real-time webhook notifications for all email events, visual email editor for non-technical users, contact management and audience segmentation, broadcast analytics, email scheduling up to 72 hours in advance, batch sending (up to 100 emails per API call), inbound email processing for support workflows, automation workflows with triggers and conditions
product_offering.problem_solved: Email deliverability failures (emails landing in spam folders), outdated developer experience with legacy email APIs (SendGrid, Mailgun, Postmark), complex email template development using table-based HTML, lack of modern SDKs and documentation, IP warming complexity for dedicated IPs, fragmented transactional and marketing email platforms
quantifiable_outcome: 63% AI agent selection rate over larger competitors
90% of urgent support requests receive first response under 1 hour 13 minutes
100 million emails successfully migrated for single customer (Gumroad)
product_offering.product_overview: Resend is a developer-focused email communications platform offering a unified product portfolio centered on its Email API core, supplemented by SMTP Service for traditional protocol support, Inbound Emails for receiving and processing incoming messages, and Automations for workflow-based email sequences. The platform's contact management capabilities include Audiences for segmentation and Broadcasts for marketing campaigns, supported by a Templates system powered by the React Email open-source component library. Key add-on modules include Webhooks for real-time event notifications, Test Mode for safe experimentation, Batch API for bulk sending, Schedule Email API for time-delayed delivery, Deliverability Insights for inbox placement optimization, Managed Dedicated IPs for sender reputation control, and Multi-Region routing for reduced latency. The company has expanded through acquisitions of Mergent (infrastructure management) and Briefer (data notebooks), while maintaining community engagement programs like Resend Insiders and hosting the annual Resend Forward developer conference.

profiles.name: Zeno Rocha
profiles.overview: Founder and CEO of Resend, leading the company as a developer-first email platform; previously CPO at Liferay Cloud and VP of Developer Experience at WorkOS.
profiles.profile_commentary: Zeno Rocha is the founder and CEO of Resend and a well-known figure in the developer tools ecosystem. He previously served as Chief Product Officer at Liferay Cloud and as VP of Developer Experience at WorkOS, accumulating deep experience building products and developer communities. He led Resend through the Y Combinator Winter 2023 batch and the $3M seed round in July 2023, then through the $18M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz in December 2024. Under his leadership, Resend scaled to 3 million users by June 2026 and grew enterprise customers including Vercel, eBay, Warner Bros, Max, MrBeast, Valentino, and A24. His product and DX background aligns tightly with Resend's developer-first positioning and the launch of the React Email open-source project.

expansion_highlight.description: Two completed acquisitions in 2025 — Mergent (April 23, 2025, infrastructure management) and Briefer (August 5, 2025, data notebooks) — signal a deliberate platform expansion beyond pure email into adjacent developer infrastructure. The pace and sequencing suggest an active inorganic growth strategy post Series A.

Inbound Emails (November 2025), Automations (2026), MCP Server (2025), Resend CLI / CLI 2.0 (2026), Schedule Email API (August 2024), Deliverability Insights (August 2024), Scale plan (October 2024), and Enterprise plan (2024) collectively broaden the platform from a send-only API into a full email communications suite (receive, automate, broadcast, schedule, analyze).

Launch of an explicit Enterprise plan (2024) with dedicated Slack channels, critical ticket severity, and domain expert access indicates upmarket movement. Hiring of two Founding Account Executives (Aneil Singh, Trey Knowles), a GTM Engineer (Sophia Faria), and a Recruiter (Areia Spinner) confirms field-sales buildout targeting Fortune-class logos.

Multi-region sending infrastructure currently spans North America (Virginia), Europe (Ireland), and South America (Brazil); the company website also references Asian region support. Operating geographies formally listed as North America, Europe, South America, and Asia. Geographic expansion is co-evolving with multi-region latency/durability positioning.

Beyond Founding AEs and GTM Engineer, the team expanded across customer success engineering (Anna Ward, Brian Kerr, Pauline Chin, Jp Valery, Slater Smith, Evan Thibodeau), developer experience (Chris Pennington, Christina Martinez, Haison Ohara), software engineering (Felipe Volpone, ex-Red Hat / iFood staff engineer), and product design (Zeh Fernandes). A dedicated Recruiter hire signals headcount scaling beyond founder-led hiring.

MCP Server for AI agents, Agent Skills documentation, Agent Onboarding guides, and integration partnerships (Novu, Knock, Trigger.dev, Pipedream, Supabase, Auth0, n8n, Zapier, Paper, Playwright) indicate deliberate ecosystem and channel-partner expansion to make Resend the default email layer across adjacent platforms.
